
# foreman_discovery_rule





## Example Usage

```
# Autogenerated example with required keys
resource "foreman_discovery_rule" "example" {
  name = "compute"
}
```


## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `enabled` - (Optional) Enables or disables the discovery rule.
- `hostgroup_ids` - (Required) Assing target hostgroup by ID
- `hostname` - (Required) Specifies the name of the new host. Can be a string or extracted via facts.
- `location_ids` - (Optional) List of all locations the discovery rule can be used.
- `max_count` - (Optional) Sets the host limit, which defines, how many host can be provisioned wiht this rule. (0 = unlimited)
- `name` - (Required) Discovery Rule name.
- `organization_ids` - (Optional) List of all organizations the discovery rule can be used.
- `priority` - (Optional) Rule priority (lower integer means higher priority).
- `search` - (Required) Search query that matches specific hosts
